purpose: Test whether domain-conditioned FAS coordinates track realized counterfactual functional contribution better than construction metadata in a controlled same-scale three-parent adapter-composition family.
counterfactual_game: exact 2^3 fixed-coefficient subsets; deleting a parent sets only that parent's full-descendant coefficient to zero and does not renormalize the remaining coefficients
utility_benchmark: existing source-disjoint data/evaluation/pilot_utility.jsonl; deterministic fixed subset of 96 items/domain selected before model evaluation

fas_measurement.probe_selection: domain-conditioned active log-det, B=32, independently within Math/Medical/Science
fas_measurement.normalization: v0.11 global ancestor-column norms over the full formal candidate pool

comparators: Absolute Output + NNLS using base-query embeddings with the same selected probes
primary_metric: within each seed x functional-domain cell, Spearman rho between the three true-parent quantities and exact Shapley values; aggregate across 9 cells
secondary_metrics: Spearman rho against leave-one-parent-out contribution U(full)-U(full\{i})
false-parent leakage to Code for FAS/Absolute
interpretation_if_pass: C4 supported in the tested controlled same-scale adapter-composition family: domain-conditioned FAS ranking aligns with realized counterfactual contribution better than construction share on average. Do not claim FAS equals causal contribution.
interpretation_if_fail: Downgrade C4: FAS coordinates remain geometric ancestry descriptors; counterfactual functional-contribution interpretation is not supported by this experiment.
guardrails: No seed-11 data are used as formal Stage6 evidence.
Construction weights are metadata, not coordinate ground truth.
Shapley values may be negative and are never clipped to match nonnegative FAS coordinates.

Code is retained as a false candidate ancestor in the decomposition bank but omitted from the exact utility game because the frozen lightweight utility evaluator deliberately does not execute untrusted code.
Stage5 cross-scale C3 remains downgraded/unsupported for the tested KD recipe; Stage6 does not repair or reinterpret Stage5.
